summary: This is a 30-minute lesson plan for Grade 8 students to develop their understanding of Sri Lanka as a multicultural society. Students will analyze a real-world dilemma, inspect the provided scenario or accessible surroundings, record evidence, and compare findings. They will then present their discoveries or co-created artifacts and receive feedback from their peers.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Students will be assessed based on their participation in the group discussions and their presentation of their findings. The teacher will provide feedback on their understanding of Sri Lanka as a multicultural society and their ability to apply it to real-world scenarios.
post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: The teacher will circulate across 8 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
